title: The Sum of the k-th Powers
statementMd:
There are well-known formulas: ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/5391ac5117a06bc4bd7abe8e188ccda9e2478758.png), ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/a851dad95e7e4aa94bef8930988d272774a2601c.png), ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/f3889d7d5f09f3428aeddd86bfda56c7e162121a.png). Also mathematicians found similar formulas for higher degrees.

Find the value of the sum ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/22622446a1c46d96c309737feb64ab8fed90c030.png) modulo $10^{9} + 7$ (so you should find the remainder after dividing the answer by the value $10^{9} + 7$).

## Input

The only line contains two integers $*n*, *k*$ ($1 ≤ *n* ≤ 10^{9}, 0 ≤ *k* ≤ 10^{6}$).

## Output

Print the only integer $*a*$ — the remainder after dividing the value of the sum by the value $10^{9} + 7$.
